metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Sigmund Freud
records.biography_en: In The Couch Has Notes, Sigmund Freud takes the role of wry historical analyst. “Tell me about the cushion.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: short gray pointed beard, round spectacles, compact dark waistcoat, small notebook at flank.

records.name: Ada Wordchain
records.biography_en: In The Couch Has Notes, Ada Wordchain takes the role of eager free associator. “The bell reminded me of an apple.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: short ribbon of three tactile pictogram beads, a key, an apple and a bell.

records.name: Bram Slipword
records.biography_en: In The Couch Has Notes, Bram Slipword takes the role of embarrassed verbal slip. “That was the other word.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: two mismatched speech-shaped clay tokens held against chest, blank surfaces.

records.name: Nora Couchfold
records.biography_en: In The Couch Has Notes, Nora Couchfold takes the role of skeptical analysand. “I brought my own couch.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small upholstered chaise cushion with a folded rug corner, held in hand.

records.name: Giles Defence
records.biography_en: In The Couch Has Notes, Giles Defence takes the role of defensive intellectualizer. “I have a theory about that theory.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: thick hardcover held like a miniature shield.

records.name: Theo Dreamnote
records.biography_en: In The Couch Has Notes, Theo Dreamnote takes the role of sleepy keeper of dreams. “I wrote it down before waking.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small bedside notebook and old brass pencil.
